blocks.text: MANILA, Philippines — President Ferdinand Marcos Jr. does not consider political affiliations when appointing officials as long as they can help improve government services. The Palace made the statement amid questions over the president’s decision to bring former Diehard Duterte Supporter (DDS) blogger Rey Joseph “RJ” Nieto into Malacañang. Palace press officer Claire Castro said on Wednesday that Marcos would not hesitate to appoint someone who could help the government, regardless of the person’s political background. “Even before, we have said that the president does not look at political colors,” Castro said. “If you can be seen as an asset to the […]...
